sources.title: Ravens sign veteran running back Jonathan Ward
sources.description: On the morning after a victory over the Philadelphia Eagles in their 2026 preseason opener, the Baltimore Ravens have reportedly made a running back addition. According to KPRC2’s Aaron Wilson, the Ravens signed veteran Jonathan Ward on Sunday. Ward is a five-year veteran who has played for four teams in the NFL thus far. He […]
